title: 외력 25 N · RBY1 + Panda

report.planner_scope: supplied straight base/SE3 path; coupled nominal arm/object inertial wrench allocation
limitations: supplied initial grasp, straight corridor, SE3 path and handover schedule
synthetic source and grasp capability; assumed inner servos and 40 Nm wheel bound
official chassis support meshes skid at low friction; passive caster rolling not modeled
convex hulls of official arm OBJ and chassis pieces; native hand visual geometry has no collision model; no continuous geometry certificate

robustness.scope: one deterministic world-Y pulse at COM; same plan/gains, not a robustness certificate

description: Differential-drive RBY1-A and one fixed Panda cooperate on a free panel. Panda supports the initial lift and hands over; RBY1 drives beyond fixed-base reach, seats the panel and releases both tools. Mobile base and panel poses are measured, never prescribed. Synthetic source refinement and target wrench allocation run with supplied path/modes. Chassis passive supports use low-friction skid approximation; wheel torque bounds and inner servo gains are simulation assumptions. No hardware execution or continuous geometry certificate. Prespecified external world-Y sin-squared force pulse at panel COM, 16–16.5 s. Measured recovery and capability checks are reported separately.
